subject: Vendor settlement routing + PO linkback for Lakeside Supplies
messages:
From: Harper Stone <harper@lakeside-supplies.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor bank details + remittance format for Redwood PO linkage

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier — attached is our bank letter (lakeside_bank_letter.pdf) and a quick remittance sample. We prefer ACH (USD) for standard payouts; for larger/urgent transfers we can accept wire (SWIFT: LKSUS33XXX). Account details are below (we can provide a notarized bank letter if you need it):

- Company: Lakeside Supplies, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Bank: First Harbor Bank
- Routing (ACH): 111000025
- Account: 987654321
- Account type: Checking

Remittance / PO linkage: We can accept the PO number in the remittance reference (format PO-#####) and also read an extra column in a CSV/flat file mapping: invoice_number,invoice_amount,po_number,invoice_date. I attached a tiny CSV sample inline and as lakeside_remit_sample.csv.

If you prefer EDI/ASN instead of CSV, our integration partner Procurely (cc'd Ari) can help.

Attachments: lakeside_bank_letter.pdf, lakeside_remit_sample.csv, lakeside_w9.pdf

Let us know if you need the routing information in a different envelope or a signed vendor agreement.

Best,
Harper Stone
Director of Finance
Lakeside Supplies
harper@lakeside-supplies.com
+1 (415) 555-0219
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Harper Stone <harper@lakeside-supplies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2025 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor bank details + remittance format for Redwood PO linkage

Harper — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items before our FinOps team runs the micro-deposit: 

1) Can you confirm the exact legal entity name that should appear on the vendor record (matching W9)? You listed "Lakeside Supplies, Inc." but want to double-check on any DBA.
2) We'll run a two-step micro-deposit to the ACH account. Do you want us to notify a specific email when the second verification arrives, or should we use harper@lakeside-supplies.com?
3) For PO linkage, Redwood's AP prefers a single remittance reference field up to 35 chars. PO-##### is fine, but please confirm whether your ERP expects the PO in a separate CSV column (po_number) or only in the reference string. The CSV sample helps — can you confirm the exact header names (case-sensitive) you will send?
4) For wires: please include the intermediary bank instructions if any for USD wires.

I'll attach our vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf for your records; Marissa / Jordan — once Harper confirms the W9 entity and CSV headers, can we proceed with micro-deposit and DocuSign for the vendor terms?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0133
From: Harper Stone <harper@lakeside-supplies.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Sato <ari.sato@procurely.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor bank details + remittance format for Redwood PO linkage

Vivek / Marissa — thanks. Confirmations below: 

1) Legal entity: Lakeside Supplies, Inc. (same as W9 — attached lakeside_w9.pdf). No DBA.
2) Please notify harper@lakeside-supplies.com for the micro-deposit verification.
3) CSV headers we send are exactly: invoice_number,invoice_amount,po_number,invoice_date,remit_reference. We will populate po_number with the PO-##### string (no prefix other than PO-). We can also echo PO in remit_reference for systems that only read a single field.
4) Wire path for USD:
   - Beneficiary bank: First Harbor Bank
   - SWIFT: LKSUS33XXX
   - Beneficiary account: 987654321
   - Intermediary: GlobalWire Bank (if routed via GBPUSD clearing)

Attachments: lakeside_remit_sample.csv (sample with header), lakeside_w9.pdf

Forwarding Ari from Procurely — Ari, if Redwood wants to ingest a secure SFTP drop with CSVs, we can coordinate mapping and schedule.

Best,
Harper
